Condition : 2 - INFORMATIVE: 

The applicant is advised that the roof extension proposed as part of this application must be fully completed before works begin on the single storey rear extension approved by Planning Application reference 00480/65/P2 granted on the 8th April 2004. If any work commences on the single-storey rear extension before completion of the roof extension, this Certificate of Lawfulness will be rendered invalid and the roof extension will require planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on the 8th June 2004, the matter described above is lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

The proposed extension to the dwellinghouse of a gable end extending 3.62m from the existing hipped ridgeline, being 2.48m high and having a base width of 7.8m, with a volume of 11.55m3, as well as a rear dormer with dimensions of 3.55m deep, 2.38m high with a width of 4.74m, that adds 20.02m3 together with the existing rear extension, which has a volume of 21.99m3, providing a total extension volume of 53.56m3 to the original dwellinghouse, qualifies as Class B and C permitted development within Part 1 of Schedule 2 of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 and therefore, does not require planning permission.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of roof extension incorporating conversion from hip to gable to dwellinghouse.
